name: Toggle
description: A pressed-state button for binary preferences in toolbars and filter rows.

anatomy.description: The pressable control carrying aria-pressed for its on/off state.
Compact content, usually icon-sized, named by aria-label when icon-only.
The data-state styling that visually distinguishes on from off.

dos: Use for binary states that apply immediately, like Bold or a filter flag.
Give icon-only toggles an aria-label naming the option.
Group related toggles in a Toolbar or ToggleGroup.
donts: Don't use for settings that need explanation; use Switch with a label.
Don't use a toggle to fire a one-shot action; use a Button.

examples.title: Pressed state
examples.description: aria-pressed and data-state reflect the current value; tint follows.

examples.title: Filter rows
examples.description: Use toggles in a toolbar for independent on/off preferences.

guidance.useWhen: A preference flips between two states inside a toolbar or filter row.
guidance.avoidWhen: The choice needs a label with explanation; use Switch or Checkbox.
guidance.behavior: aria-pressed reflects the value and the pressed tint follows.
guidance.responsive: Keep toggle content icon-sized so rows stay compact.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the toggle.

notes: Exposes its state through aria-pressed, announced as a pressed or not-pressed toggle button.
Icon-only toggles require aria-label to have an accessible name.

apiEntries.description:
A two-state button that toggles a single option on or off, such as a
formatting choice. Renders the pressed state as `aria-pressed`.
